description: Categorical field representing race or ethnicity. Contains 30 records with no missing values and 6 distinct observed values representing three semantic categories (Chinese, Malay, Indian) with casing inconsistencies: 'Malay' appears as 'Malay', 'MALAY', and 'malay'; 'Indian' appears as 'Indian' and 'indian'; 'Chinese' appears consistently in title case.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Unify casing variations to title case: 'MALAY' → 'Malay', 'malay' → 'Malay', 'indian' → 'Indian'.
